counter_semantics.PERF.pub: Frame publish calls counted before async queue acceptance, including invalid/partial frames and subsequent drops; not ADC conversion count.
counter_semantics.PERF.emitQueued: NOT_REPORTED unless the firmware actually supplies this field; no substitute is inferred.
counter_semantics.PERF.fresh: Firmware freshness classification; partial CRC freshness is not a route-fault verdict.
counter_semantics.PERF.usbSent: When usbStage=queued: packets submitted to the serial sink, not PC receipt or driver completion.
counter_semantics.PERF.usbBytes: Bytes submitted at the USB sink stage identified by usbStage.
counter_semantics.PERF.usbDrop: USB sink packet rejection counter; not necessarily equivalent to scientific frame gaps.
counter_semantics.PERF.queueDrop: Transport descriptor queue drops; preserve separately from USB counters.
counter_semantics.USBSTREAM.sinkQueued: Accepted serial sink slots (data, diagnostics and replies), not frames.
counter_semantics.USBSTREAM.sinkDropped: Sink failures, including line-drop events; do not add lineDropped again.
counter_semantics.USBSTREAM.driverAcceptedBytes: Bytes accepted by the ESP-IDF driver, not acknowledgement from the PC.
counter_semantics.USBSTREAM.driverDrained: Observed successful wait_tx_done checks; neither bytes nor frames nor PC receipt.
counter_semantics.USBSTREAM.rxBytes: Firmware command RX bytes; distinct from collector raw received bytes.
counter_semantics.USBSTREAM.lineDropped: Line assembler drops; a scientific frame can have a different loss count.
counter_semantics.USBSTREAM.partialWrite: A serial sink packet deadline expired after some bytes were accepted.
counter_semantics.USBSTREAM.timeout: A serial sink packet was not completely accepted before its deadline.
counter_semantics.enumerated: Preserve unknown; SOF presence does not prove host application receipt.
counter_semantics.BL50.mq: Firmware BLE messages queued; keep separate from messages sent and host receipt.
counter_semantics.BL50.sentD: Firmware data-message send success path after fragment sends; notifications do not acknowledge host application receipt.
counter_semantics.BL50.dropD: Firmware BLE data-message drops, not interchangeable with host frame gaps.
counter_semantics.BL50.fs: Firmware successful fragment-send paths; a different layer from journal notifications and reassembled frames.
counter_semantics.BLE.MTU: Firmware BL50.mtu is preserved; backend_reported MTU is not treated as negotiated verification.

ble_journal.incomplete_fragment_meaning: unobserved parts at an explicit disconnect/end/prefix boundary; never inferred from message-ID jumps

configuration_table.selection_rule: Keep the initial suite-01 run whenever its requested capture window completed, including runs with errors. Only absent/short initial windows use the earliest complete fallback (for example retry-01). All attempts remain in the report; FPS is never a selection criterion.

USB_comparison.unmatched_meaning: No trusted fingerprint match; a partial or identity-rejected frame may still exist in the other raw recording. This is not a literal byte-absence or independent loss count.
USB_comparison.basis: SHA256 of original scientific header/data/PGA/row/K bytes including line endings, after both CRC and identity checks; no CRC rewriting or sample reconstruction

rates.capture_basis: ordered CRC-and-identity-valid frame sequence progression / device timestamp span
rates.host_basis: (trusted complete frames - 1) / first-to-last trusted K receipt time; bad CRC, incomplete/mismatched identity and wire-contract failures excluded

bytes.definition: wire=header+data/PGA/row lines+K including newlines; payload=data/PGA/row lines; diagnostics excluded

window.rule: header and K receipts both inside explicit capture window; straddlers excluded

rejected_frame_diagnostics.identity_mismatch_semantics: Value mismatches are observed text disagreements, not proof of a device configuration change; truncated numeric tokens can still be syntactically valid.

sequence.missing_semantics: missing CRC-and-identity-valid sequence observations; rejected complete frames can contribute, so do not add this count to CRC errors as independent losses
sequence.arithmetic: u32 modulo; distance 0 or >=2^31 is duplicate/old; never across identity groups

captures.quality_count_scope: Only ordered frames passing CRC, complete identity and the requested wire contract enter point-quality totals; rejected frames remain separate. complete_frames is parsed framing, trusted_complete_frames is the trustworthy subset.
captures.sequence_scope_note: Use group sequence statistics; the legacy parser whole-raw sequence counters are not boot/configuration aware.

ads_health.missing_boundary_records: NOT_ASSUMED_SUCCESSFUL; targets absent from maps are NOT_OBSERVED
ads_health.scope: diagnostic receipt window; queued logs may predate the first captured data identity; original seq/entry retained

telemetry_integrity.policy: STK50 memory requires the full emitted field layout through the named trunc suffix. PERF requires its full emitted layout; earlier heap/usbStackMin fields have following delimiters, but terminal heapMin has no following marker or CRC and remains unknown. No value-magnitude threshold is used; structural validation is not a checksum.
telemetry_integrity.numeric_minima_source: Only structurally complete capture-window STK50 records; unverified values remain diagnostic text.

memory.stack_scope: observed capture-window STK50 lifetime watermarks; PERF/USB query fields preserved separately

CTRL.counts_scope: whole independent raw stream; fault/reset phases and selected counter endpoints use the capture window

CDC.counts_scope: whole independent raw stream; fault/reset phases and selected counter endpoints use the capture window

adc_crc.denominator: crcValidEven + crcValidOdd + crcErrors deltas; checked reads, including retry attempts, not frames
adc_crc.scope: first/last complete ADSHEALTH receipt inside capture, not exact window endpoints

semantics: CDC0 control records are selected from the same raw stream; CDC1 debug never enters scientific CRC, identity, gap or FPS calculations.
Missing diagnostics are NOT_OBSERVED, not zero or proof of healthy operation.
Diagnostic layouts have no ASCII checksum; terminal numeric fields remain unverified.
USB accepted/callback bytes and BLE SDK acceptance do not acknowledge PC receipt.
SCHED observes idle progress and bounded work; it is not CPU utilization.

clock_alignment.basis: CTRL relative event time anchored to capture_start; CDC explicit host monotonic timestamps; no device timestamp substitution

captures.diagnostic_source_policy: Formal CDC0 DATA/CTRL share one raw stream; use otg_diagnostics for control records and independent CDC1 debug. Missing telemetry is not zero.

limitations: ASCII CRC success does not establish ADC SPI integrity, freshness, or analog accuracy.
RECORDED means requested time/configuration were observed; inspect invalid samples, faults and drops separately.
Query counter intervals bracket their own timestamps, not exact capture boundaries.
No rates or counter deltas are inferred across boots; group timestamps use microseconds.
Counter decreases are left unresolved; sequence wraps use u32 half-range arithmetic.
Raw ADC samples, CPU utilization, and maximum contiguous heap block cannot be reconstructed from absent fields.
